semantic_fragments.content: Indicator lights color coding requirements: Red indicator lights mean Warning (immediate response by OPERATOR required); Yellow indicator lights mean Caution (prompt response by OPERATOR required); Green indicator lights mean Ready for use. Red used only for emergency control.

Instructions for use when PATIENT is an intended OPERATOR must include: statement that the PATIENT is an intended OPERATOR; warning against servicing and maintenance while the ME EQUIPMENT is in use; functions the PATIENT can safely use and which functions the PATIENT cannot safely use; maintenance the PATIENT can perform.

The device PT9L has no protective earth conductor, is not Class I equipment, and accompanying documents are provided on paper rather than electronically. Several clauses related to protective earth conductors and power supply cord colors are marked N/A.
